steps.title: Prep the pan
steps.body: Line a 9×13 pan with foil or parchment, and sprinkle with **½ cup coarsely chopped almonds**.

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.body: Butter sides of heavy 2 quart pan, and over medium-high heat, melt **1 cup butter**.

steps.title: Cook the toffee
steps.body: Stir in **1 cup sugar**, **3 Tbsp water** and **1 Tbsp light corn syrup**. Cook and stir until it boils, then stir until it reaches 290°F (soft crack). Watch closely after 280°F to prevent burning.

steps.title: Pour and top
steps.body: Remove from heat, and pour toffee into the prepared pan. Let cool for about 5 minutes, then sprinkle with **¾ cup chocolate chips**.

steps.title: Spread the chocolate
steps.body: Wait for 2-3 minutes, until chocolate is melted, then spread evenly over surface and sprinkle with **½ cup fine chopped almonds**.

steps.title: Cool and break
steps.body: Cool, then cut/break into pieces and hide.
